name: Simple Macedonian Dynasty - Beasty
author: Niki45nk

notes: 2@unit_worker/villager.webp@ make 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ on the side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ near the @resource/berrybush.webp@
Rally 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@, then back to @resource/sheep.webp@
Put all @resource/sheep.webp@ on side of @building_economy/town-center.webp@ nearest to the @resource/berrybush.webp@
[Make sure its eco bonus radius extends to the 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@]
[If against Knight or Horse Civ, build @building_macedonian/varangian_stronghold.webp@ into @unit_macedonian/atgeir-1.webp@ and @unit_macedonian/bogmadr-2.webp@]

When 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, Rally @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until 11 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
[Now you can either go into Feudal Rush to Age-Up to Castle Age]

Send 5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 10 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@

6 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ in a forward position near @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ (if possible)
Upgrade your units and start making @unit_macedonian/riddari-3.webp@

description: Simple Macedonian Dynasty Build Order by Beasty
